about_the_game:
A Blackjack Roguelike in the Underworld: Bet Your Soul to Win Reincarnation

Story

You awaken in an underworld gambling hall, moments away from having your soul devoured by Ammit.
Just as all hope seems lost, you are offered a final bargain:
Survive twelve hours until dawn by continuously offering chips as tribute, and you may earn a chance at reincarnation.

With the clock ticking and your soul on the edge, can you seize this last opportunity and return to life?

Core Mechanics

To survive the twelve hours before dawn, you must meet Ammit’s demanded tribute of chips every hour.

  • Each in-game hour allows up to three blackjack challenges.

  • Gather the required chips within those three attempts.

Fail to meet the tribute, or run out of chips due to accumulated losses, and the payment must be made with your own soul.

Blackjack With Limited Knowledge

Each challenge presents a field of nine facedown cards.
You cannot see their values, but you do know their relative size ordering—a unique twist on blackjack that turns every pick into a calculated risk.

You draw cards aiming for 21, while each round gives you a target score set by the Dealer.
Unless you surpass that target, you earn nothing.

Your reward is calculated as:

(Your final score − Target score) × Item multipliers = Chips gained

Features

  • Ever-shifting items and deck compositions keep each challenge fresh.

  • Strategic risk-taking is essential to accumulate enough tribute for Ammit.

  • No matter how strong your build becomes, the final outcome rests on one thing:
    your resolve—and your luck.

short_description: ReSoul:Jack is a turn-based blackjack roguelike. Draw from nine facedown cards, using only their relative size hints to guide your choices. Combine items creatively and survive each tribute requirement on your path toward rebirth.
